headline: Six Fronts See Heavy Base Turnover
war_summary: On day 263 the strategic map remains split: Colonials dominate the northern and central hexes while Wardens hold the south‑west, with only a handful of regions showing mixed ownership — Callahans Passage (10 Warden), Farranac Coast (1 Warden/10 Colonial), Fishermans Row (1 Warden/6 Colonial/2 neutral), Stlican Shelf (7 Warden/1 Colonial/1 neutral), Stonecradle (5 Warden/4 Colonial) and Weathered Expanse (6 Warden/3 Colonial). Since the last edition three hours ago, fighting has surged in six sectors. Weathered Expanse recorded 49 ownership flips in the past 24 hours, adding roughly 11 k Colonial and 14 k Warden casualties with enlistments climbing to 643. Fishermans Row saw 34 flips and 1 k total losses (406 Colonial, 663 Warden) with 175 new enlistees. Stlican Shelf logged 27 flips and about 6.5 k casualties each side, enlistments rising to 604. Stonecradle produced 12 flips, 9 k combined casualties and 731 enlistments. Marban Hollow registered eight flips, 1.8 k casualties and 264 enlistments. Godcrofts, though quieter, still turned nine bases with 92 casualties and 89 enlistments. Most other fronts remain static, reporting only incremental losses.
